notes.title: Bug fixes and game balance modification
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we have made quite a few bug fixes and game balance changes. 
Please check them out!

[h2]Feature added[/h2]

[u][b]Now you can choose your server region for online matches[/b][/u]
We have received many reports on the lag issues for online matches and as for the temporary fix to this, we are going to grant users to choose their server to join.

Battle buddy matches can be held when players are in the same server. Please make sure to join the same server before battle buddy matches. We are planning to fix this issue in the future.

[h2]Bug Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*]Wrong arena selection
[*]There are no second colors for Vedvar and Tim but a message pops up as if such color variation would exist. These misleading messages would not be shown.
[*]After a player surpass Lv.99 and reaches to Lv.5 for the second time, a message was shown as if the online matches are now open. This message will no longer pop up.
[*]In some cases in 2 vs. 2 modes, winners and losers are flipped over; meaning winners are considered to be lost and vice versa.
[*]Some effects of guns are wrongly replaced with other guns.
[*]In some case, melee and the ultimate attack setting are not reflecting one's selections
[*]Frame skipping issues during training.
[*]Detonation sound is played when the wire detonation button is pressed even though a wire is not fired.
[*]Camera and BGM are reset in some situations during a battle.
[*]When using a controller and mouse at the same time, and also "release right click" was set for wire detonation, detonation button for controller became dysfunctional.
[*]When an AI challenges a player in the online modes, previous arcade mode's equipment combos are set.
[*]Rival certificate rate exceeds 100 million in some cases.
[*]A character was able to stand on top of the outer wall by a combination of specific weapon explosion and technique.
[/list]

notes.title: Changes made to game balance
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we have made quite a few changes to the game balance!
Please take a look!

[h2][u][b]Game Balance Adjustment[/b][/u][/h2]

[h3][u][b]OVERALL[/b][/u][/h3]
- Increased knock down time
- Increased invincible time after a knock down
- Increased time to become invincible after a knock down
- Deal less damage when attacking knocked down opponents
- Decreased ultimate gauge gain by all trackers

[h3][u][b]BODY[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Samonji:[/b]
- Lowered immobility value(easier to get knocked down)
- Slower immobility value recovery rate(takes longer to recover)
- Slower mid-air movement speed

[b]Mirabel:[/b]
- Extended the landing stiffen period(takes longer to restart after landing) 
- Lowered Resilience

[b]Clown:[/b]
- Use less gauge for land-dash
- Use less gauge for multistage jumps

[b]Balmung:[/b]
- Use less gauge for land-dash
- Faster land-dash
- Eliminated stiffening before land-dash
- Eliminated stiffening after land-dash
- Shorten the duration of land-dash

[b]Vedvar: [/b]
- Use less gauge for land-dash
- Faster land-dash
- Extended the duration of mid-air dash
- Eliminated stiffening before land-dash
- Eliminated stiffening after land-dash

[b]Rex:[/b]
- Use less gauge for mid-air dash and multistage jumps
- Use less gauge for land-dash
- Faster land-dash
- Eliminated stiffening before land-dash
- Eliminated stiffening after land-dash
- Faster restarts after mid-air dash
- Lowered immobility value(easier to get knocked down)
- Slower immobility value recovery rate(takes longer to recover)

[b]William:[/b]
- Faster mid-air movements
- Faster transitions to mid-air dash
- Shorten the land stiffening period(faster restarts after landing)

[b]Lucien:[/b]
- Use less gauge for steep dives
- Extended the mid-air dash duration

[b]Patrick:[/b]
- Lowered immobility value(easier to get knocked down)
- Lowered Resilience

[h3][u][b]GUN[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Lighting Gun: [/b]
- Lowered horizontal homing capability 
- Lowered vertical homing capability 
- Lowered damage to immobility value

[b]Triple Gun:[/b]
- Longer hit stun

[b]Sqeeze Gun:[/b]
- Extended the time to bullets performance change 
- Bigger hit area for blasts

[b]Big Ball Gun:[/b]
- Slower reload
- Lowered power and damage to immobility value
- Extended the time to bullets performance change 
- Lowered homing capability

[b]Left Side Gun:[/b]
[b]Right Side Gun:[/b]
- Faster reload

[b]Reflect Laser Gun:[/b]
- Faster bullet speed
- Longer hit stun

[b]Hammerhead Gun:[/b]
- Faster reload
- Faster reload for charge shots
- Lowered damage to immobility value
- Longer hit stun

[b]Freeze Gun:[/b]
- faster movement speed while firing
- Increased power

[b]Disrupter Gun:[/b]
- Extended the time to bullets performance change 

[b]Shotgun: [/b]
- Lowered damage to immobility value

[h3][u][b]WIRE[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]All Wires (except Auto series):[/b]
- Faster travel speed
- Increased damage to immobility value

[b]All Auto series:[/b]
- Slower travel speed
- Longer reload after blasts
- Lowered power and damage to immobility value

[h3][u][b]TRACKER[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Geo Gardian: [/b]
- Longer reload
- Lowered vertical homing capability
- Bigger sensor radius
- Lowered power and damage to immobility value

[b]Multi Gardian:[/b]
- Smaller sensor radius
- Faster travel speed within sensor radius
- Longer lasting
- Lowered power and damage to immobility value

[h3][u][b]ULTIMATE[/b][/u][/h3]
[b]Fire Swarm:[/b]
- Extended the time to start homing
- Faster travel speed
- Lowered power and damage to immobility value
- Shorter hit stun

[b]Tidal Wave:[/b]
- Extended the time to start homing
- Longer lasting
- Lowered power and damage to immobility value
- Shorter hit stun
